verdicts.reason: Settings switches without semantics labels; the row descriptions are separate nodes.
Small unlabelled buttons on Settings; their purpose is not clear from the evidence.
Semantics bounds 23dp tall; the drawn button may be larger.
'Next' belongs to the sync intro, a different view that shares the name 'Sync' with the sign-in form.
'Sign Up' link below the sign-in fields is under the keyboard; a side action rather than the form's submit.
Password visibility toggle (icon button) without a tooltip or semantics label.
Text button whose semantics bounds are 108×19dp.

notes: Flutter exposes its semantics tree to the drivers; controls without semantics labels can be unlabeled for real, so accessibility findings need a careful manual verdict.
